description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of queries used during inference and MRR@10 for different DPR models. The x-axis is labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)" with a linear scale, ranging from 1 to 10, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "MRR@10" with a linear scale, ranging from 33.0 to 36.5, and tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The plot compares the performance of five DPR models: DPR w/ gold (yellow), DPR w/ top-1 (green), DPR w/ bottom-1 (purple), DPR w/ random (blue), and DPR w/ curriculum (red). The DPR w/ gold line starts at approximately 33.2 at x=1, decreases to around 33.1 at x=4, and then increases to about 35.0 at x=10. The DPR w/ top-1 line begins at around 34.3 at x=1, dips to 33.0 at x=2, and then rises to approximately 36.5 at x=10. The DPR w/ bottom-1 line starts at around 34.7 at x=1, peaks at 35.1 at x=2, and then declines to about 34.7 at x=10. The DPR w/ random line begins at around 34.7 at x=1, increases to 35.5 at x=4, and then remains relatively steady, ending at approximately 35.4 at x=10. The DPR w/ curriculum line starts at around 35.4 at x=1, increases to 35.8 at x=4, and then remains relatively steady, ending at approximately 35.8 at x=10. Each line is represented by a distinct color and marker shape, with dashed horizontal lines corresponding to the maximum value of each line.
